title: Workshop on AI Guide
text:
Get oriented in the AI Guide on the intranet — five short pages (Ethics, Tools & Policies, Practice, Assessment, Professional Development) that between them cover the five-level usage scale, which tools carry an institutional license, and where the two governing policies live.

Rather than reading through it alone, you'll explore its core ideas together through hands-on activities — ordering the five usage levels, matching disciplinary concerns to their field, redesigning a real assignment in small groups — so you know exactly which page to come back to later and why.

You leave knowing how the Guide is organized, where its policy documents and declaration forms live, and with a concrete example of one assignment rewritten at two different levels.

We'll begin shortly — feel free to look around while you wait.
